# Indian Tests Hub

> Free, independent self-study hub for Indian competitive and entrance exams: NEET, JEE, CUET, GATE, CAT, UPSC, SSC, RRB, IBPS, SBI, state PSCs, police, teaching and armed forces. Each exam has its official pattern, a syllabus checklist, practice MCQs, timed mocks and a link to the conducting body's official site. English and Hindi.

Not an official exam portal. Not affiliated with any exam body. Applications must be submitted on the official site of the conducting body.

## Key pages
- /explore: all exams, filter by category and career stage
- /tests/[id]: pattern, syllabus, MCQ bank, mocks, jobs, alerts and apply link for one exam
- /jobs: current recruitment notices with official links
- /alerts: exam dates, admit cards and results
- /faq: common questions
